verdict.rationale: Dialpad's own docs claim AI voice agents that handle customer conversations, resolve common requests, and hand off to human agents with full context. That covers answering the line and human handoff, but rests on a single marketing-level statement, and no evidence shows the AI agent taking a message. Missing for 10: documented AI message-taking, in-depth docs on AI agent call handling and handoff configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
